script_components.description: Schemas of the script-defined components the saving world had registered.

note.description: A comment on the entity, kept by every save; the game never reads it.

Transform.description:
Position, rotation and scale relative to the parent entity (or to the
world for a root entity).

translation.description: Offset from the parent's origin, in metres.

rotation.description: Orientation relative to the parent. Normalised on write.

scale.description: Per-axis scale relative to the parent.

MeshRef.description: The mesh drawn for this entity.

asset.description:
An asset path (`assets/crate.glb`), or `derived:<hash>` for a
procedurally generated mesh.

MaterialRef.description: The material the mesh is drawn with.

visible.description: False hides the entity (it still simulates).

Camera.description: A perspective camera. The active camera renders the frame.

fov_y_deg.description: Vertical field of view, in degrees.

active.description: True for the camera that renders the frame (one at a time).

Light.description: A light source. A directional light shines along the entity's -Z axis.

intensity.description: Intensity: lumens for point lights, lux for directional lights.

range.description: Distance in metres beyond which a point light has no effect.

RigidBody.description:
Makes the entity a physics body. Needs a [`Collider`] to collide; a
[`Collider`] without a `RigidBody` is a static body.

kind.description: Static (never moves), dynamic (simulated) or kinematic (moved by code).

center_of_mass_offset.description:
Moves the centre of mass from the shape's own, in the body's local
space, in metres (dynamic bodies only). A vehicle chassis lowers it to
stay upright.

Collider.description:
A collision shape, in the entity's local space.

`re_app` maps it to a `re_types::physics::BodyDesc`: without a
[`RigidBody`] the body is static, and `enabled = false` removes the body.
`Mesh` and `Heightfield` shapes are static only (`re_physics` refuses them
on dynamic and kinematic bodies with `RE5003`).

half_extents.description: Half extents of a box, in metres.

radius.description: Radius of a sphere or capsule, in metres.

half_height.description: Half height of a capsule's cylindrical part, in metres.

source.description:
The mesh or heightfield asset for Convex, Mesh and Heightfield shapes. A
heightfield asset carries its sample count per side (`n`), `spacing` and
`offset` as well as the samples.

layer.description:
Object layer, 0 to 65535 (`re_types::physics::Layer`); the physics layer
table decides which layers collide.

groups.description:
Collision group bit mask, 0 to `u32::MAX` (`re_types::physics::GroupMask`:
bit `g` is group `g`, so the default 1 is group 0). Queries and characters
only see bodies whose groups intersect theirs.

sensor.description: A sensor reports contacts but does not collide.

enabled.description: False removes the body from the simulation.

step_height.description: Highest step climbed without jumping, in metres.

mass.description: Mass in kilograms, used when pushing bodies.

inner_body.description: True adds an inner rigid body, so the character takes part in contact events.

groups.description:
Collision group bit mask, 0 to `u32::MAX`, as in [`Collider`]. The
character only collides with bodies whose groups intersect these.

ScriptRef.description: A Luau script attached to the entity.

path.description: Script path relative to the project (`scripts/game/player.luau`).

context.description: The context (VM) the script runs in.

clip.description: A project asset path such as `assets/sfx/pickup.wav`, as in `AudioCmd`.

looping.description: Restart the clip when it ends.

spatial.description: Attenuate and pan by the entity's position.

autoplay.description: Start playing when the entity appears.

bus.description:
The mixer bus it plays on (ADR-0041); empty for the project's
`default_bus`.

rate.description:
Playback speed, above 0: 1 is normal, and the pitch shifts with the
speed. A source plays at most 16 times as fast.

rolloff.description:
How a spatial sound's volume falls with distance: `Natural` (the
level in decibels falls evenly to silence at `max_distance`),
`Inverse` (the physical law: -6 dB at each doubling of distance
beyond `min_distance`, keeping its level beyond `max_distance`),
`Linear` (the amplitude falls evenly to silence at `max_distance`)
or `Off` (it only pans).

min_distance.description:
Within this distance, in metres, the sound plays at full volume: 0
or more, and above 0 for `Inverse`.

max_distance.description: Where the fall with distance ends, in metres, above `min_distance`.

doppler.description:
How much the pitch follows the source's and the listener's motion
along the line between them (doppler): 0 is none, 1 is physical,
and more exaggerates.

AnimPlayer.description: Plays a node animation clip from a glTF asset.

clip.description:
`<model asset path>#<clip name>`, e.g. `assets/models/door.glb#open`; the
clip name is `ClipData.name` (the glTF animation name, or
`animation_<index>`). Playback time is runtime state in `re_app`, not a
field.

looping.description: Restart the clip when it ends.

HudText.description: A line of text drawn on the heads-up display.

text.description: The text. It breaks into lines only at its `\n`s.

color.description: Linear colour of the text; its alpha fades it.

Procedural.description: Makes this entity the source of generated entities.

seed.description: Seed for the generator's random choices.

version.description:
The generator version this source was written for (ADR-0043).
The generator runs as that version; files without the field
mean 1.

GraphSource.description:
Parameters of the `graph` generator (a ProcGraph, ARCHITECTURE §5).
Names either a `builder` script or a `graph` file.

builder.description: A builder script in the tools context (`scripts/tools/island_graph.luau`).

params.description:
Per-node parameter overrides as canonical JSON:
`{"<node id>": {"<param>": <value>}}`.

Attributes.description: Named values attached to the entity by scripts, the editor or agents.

values.description: The attributes by name. Values are bools, numbers, strings, vectors, colours, enum names, records, or lists of those.

Tags.description: String labels on the entity, found through the tag index.

tags.description: The tags, each at most once, in the order they were added.

SkinnedMesh.description:
A skinned mesh from a glTF asset, posed by its skeleton (ADR-0039).

The skeleton starts at its rest pose; an [`AnimPlayer`] on the same
entity plays a clip onto its joints, matched by joint name. Joints are
not entities.

asset.description:
`<model asset path>#<skin name>`, e.g. `assets/models/hero.glb#Armature`;
the skin name is `SkinData.name` (the glTF skin name, or `skin_<index>`).

Streamed.description:
Streams this entity by cell (ADR-0042). On a procedural source (which
must have an identity transform), its generator's output is applied
per cell; on an authored root entity, the entity and its subtree are
unloaded with the cell holding its translation.

bounds.description:
For a procedural source: the half side, in metres, of the square
around the world origin it generates (cells touching it are its
cells); 0 is unbounded. Unused on authored entities.

StreamFocus.description:
A point the streamed world loads around: the player, a vehicle, the
editor camera. With none, the active camera is the focus.

Vehicle.description:
Makes a dynamic [`RigidBody`] a wheeled vehicle chassis (ADR-0040). Its
wheels are the child entities with a [`VehicleWheel`], in child order;
each wheel's [`Transform`] when the vehicle is created is its attachment
point, and `re_app` writes the simulated wheel pose back to it. Scripts
drive it with `physics.drive`.

kind.description: Wheeled (any number of wheels) or motorcycle (two wheels that lean).

max_torque.description: Engine torque at full throttle, in newton metres.

min_rpm.description: Idle engine speed, in revolutions per minute.

max_rpm.description: Highest engine speed, in revolutions per minute.

gears.description: Forward gear ratios, first gear first.

shift_up_rpm.description: Engine speed that shifts up, in revolutions per minute.

shift_down_rpm.description: Engine speed that shifts down, in revolutions per minute.

differential_ratio.description: Ratio between gearbox and driven wheels.

anti_roll_stiffness.description: Anti-roll bar stiffness on each two-wheel axle; 0 adds none.

max_pitch_roll_deg.description: Steepest pitch or roll the chassis may reach, in degrees; 180 is free.

tester.description: How the wheels find the ground.

tester_radius.description: Sphere radius of the `CastSphere` tester, in metres.

VehicleWheel.description: One wheel of the [`Vehicle`] on the entity's parent.

max_steer_deg.description: Steering angle at full steer, in degrees; 0 does not steer.

max_brake_torque.description: Brake torque at full brake, in newton metres.

max_hand_brake_torque.description: Hand brake torque, in newton metres; 0 has no hand brake.

driven.description: True if the engine drives this wheel.

Ragdoll.description:
Gives a [`SkinnedMesh`] a ragdoll on its skeleton (ADR-0040). Once the skin
loads, `re_app` generates the parts (one capsule per listed joint along its
bone, humanoid joint limits, the mass split by volume), keeps an animated
ragdoll on the animation, and shows the simulated pose blended in while it is
simulated or powered. Scripts switch it with `physics.ragdoll`. The entity
has no `RigidBody`; a `CharacterController` on it is fine and never collides
with its own ragdoll.

joints.description:
The joints that get parts, by name; empty finds a humanoid's hips, spine,
head, upper arms, forearms, thighs and shins by name.

mode.description: How it moves when the scene starts, and after each edit of this field.

blend_seconds.description:
Seconds the shown pose takes to blend from the animation to the ragdoll
and back; 0 switches at once.

Animator.description:
Plays an animation graph (ADR-0039, `*.animgraph.json`) on the
[`SkinnedMesh`] of the same entity, in place of an [`AnimPlayer`].
Parameters and state-machine state are runtime state in `re_app`;
scripts reach them through the `anim` library.

playing.description: Whether the graph advances; while false the pose holds.

speed.description: Playback speed multiplier for the whole graph (0 or more).

BoneAttachment.description:
Places this entity at a joint of its parent's [`SkinnedMesh`] each
fixed step: its `Transform` becomes the joint's model-space transform,
which is relative to the parent because the skin's space is the
parent's (ADR-0039). Put an offset on a child of this entity. It is
placed at the end of the step, after physics and the ragdoll blend, so
`PostSimulation` scripts see the previous step's placement.

joint.description: The joint's name in the parent's skin.

AudioListener.description:
Where sounds are heard from. The first active `AudioListener`, in
entity order, hears; without one, the first active camera does. The
listener faces -Z, as a camera does.

active.description: Whether this listener can be the one that hears.

UiRoot.description:
Makes this entity the root of a native UI tree (ADR-0058): its
children with a [`UiNode`] are the tree's nodes. On the screen the root
fills the view; in the world it is a box at this entity's position that
faces the camera, as wide and tall as its own `UiNode`'s size.

space.description: On the screen or in the world.

order.description: Screen roots draw by order, lowest first, then by stable id.

focus.description: Takes keyboard and gamepad focus and navigation while shown.

input.description: False lets the pointer pass through to the game, as for a HUD.

reference_height.description:
The view height in the root's units: 0 makes a unit a point, 720
lays out for a 720-point-high view and scales to the real one.

theme.description:
A theme file for this root in place of the project's `[ui] theme`
(empty: the project's).

world_height.description: World roots: the metres the root's height spans.

offset.description: World roots: where the root's centre is from this entity, in metres.

max_distance.description:
World roots: hidden further than this from the camera, in metres
(0: no limit).

UiNode.description:
A box in a native UI tree (ADR-0058): its place, size and layout. Its
parent is the entity's parent, which has a `UiNode` or a [`UiRoot`] (a
node under any other entity is not drawn); its children are its
children with a `UiNode`, in child order. Sizes and positions are a
fraction of the parent's box (`_scale`) plus points.

x.description: Left edge from the parent's, in points.

y.description: Top edge from the parent's, in points.

x_scale.description: Left edge from the parent's, as a fraction of its width.

y_scale.description: Top edge from the parent's, as a fraction of its height.

width_scale.description: Width as a fraction of the parent's.

height_scale.description: Height as a fraction of the parent's.

anchor_x.description: The point of the box placed at the position: 0 left, 1 right.

anchor_y.description: The point of the box placed at the position: 0 top, 1 bottom.

auto_size.description: Which axes grow to fit the text and the children.

padding_left.description: Space inside the left edge, in points.

padding_top.description: Space inside the top edge, in points.

padding_right.description: Space inside the right edge, in points.

padding_bottom.description: Space inside the bottom edge, in points.

min_width.description: The smallest width in points (0: none).

min_height.description: The smallest height in points (0: none).

max_width.description: The largest width in points (0: none).

max_height.description: The largest height in points (0: none).

aspect.description: Width over height, kept inside the size given (0: none).

gap.description: Space between the children of a row, column or grid, in points.

align_x.description: Where a row, column or grid sits across the box.

align_y.description: Where a row, column or grid sits down the box.

cell_width.description: A grid's cell width in points.

cell_height.description: A grid's cell height in points.

max_cells.description: A grid's cells per line (0: as many as fit).

order.description:
The place among its siblings in a row, column or grid, lowest
first; ties keep child order.

z.description: Drawn over siblings with a lower z.

visible.description: False hides the box and everything under it.

clip.description: Cuts off what the children draw outside the box.

scale.description: Scales the box and everything under it about its centre.

rotation_deg.description: Turns the box and everything under it about its centre, in degrees.

opacity.description:
Multiplies the alpha of the box and everything under it, 0 to 1.
No style sets it, so it fades any node.

style.description: The theme's style that gives the box its look (empty: none).

UiPanel.description:
Fills a [`UiNode`]'s box, with rounded corners, an outline or a
gradient.

gradient.description: The linear colour the fill blends to across the box (alpha 0: none).

gradient_angle_deg.description: The blend's direction in degrees: 0 left to right, clockwise.

align_x.description: Where the text sits across the box.

align_y.description: Where the text sits down the box.

fit.description: Takes the largest size that fits the box, in place of `size`.

truncate.description: Ends text that does not fit with an ellipsis.

rich.description:
Reads `<b>`, `<font color="#rrggbb">`, `<font size="n">` and the
XML escapes.

line_height.description: Line spacing: 1 is the font's own.

outline_color.description: Linear colour of a one-point outline (alpha 0: none).

tint.description: Linear colour the texture is multiplied by.

UiButton.description:
Makes a [`UiNode`] a button: it takes the pointer, focus and presses,
and raises its events (ADR-0058).

enabled.description: False shows the style's disabled state and takes no presses.

auto_color.description:
Darkens the panel on hover and press when the style gives no colour
for those states.

UiBar.description:
Fills part of a [`UiNode`]'s box from one edge: a progress or health
bar.

UiScroll.description:
Makes a [`UiNode`] a scrolling view of a content area larger than its
box.

scroll_x.description:
How far the content is scrolled right, in points. Layout keeps the
view inside the content without writing this back.

scroll_y.description: How far the content is scrolled down, in points.

content_width.description: The content's width in points (0: grows to fit the children).

content_height.description: The content's height in points (0: grows to fit the children).

bar.description: The scroll bar's width in points.

bar_color.description: Linear colour of the scroll bar.

UiTextInput.description:
Makes a [`UiNode`] with a [`UiText`] a text field: its text is the
`UiText`'s.

placeholder.description: Shown, faded, while the text is empty.

max_length.description: The most characters it takes (0: no limit).

clear_on_focus.description: Empties the text when the field takes focus.
